title: CopperWorld
description: This mod will turn your entire world into copper! More presets coming soon!
body:
This mod is very command based. All commands start with /CopperWorld.

The terrain editor has branched off my FractalWorld mod, and has a lot of similar commands like setting the column loading speed, just instead of turning the world into a fractal, it maps all of the blocks to a new color pallette! For example, Copper!

Using this mod is easy! To start it, use /CopperWorld on. You can also adjust it's speed and more using /CopperWorld Set. 

More commands and world presets coming soon!

Showcase and Gameplay: https://youtu.be/nK1ITwzUkMo
